2.declaration_header:
theorem sc27_safe (E : Env) (ops : List Op)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (chainHead E.H E.h0) {l | l ∈ (run E full init ops).accepted ∨
      ∃ a ∈ (run E full init ops).anchors, a.2 = some l}) :
    ∀ m ∈ (run E full init ops).accepted, ∃ a ∈ (run E full init ops).anchors, a.2 = some m

3.declaration_header:
theorem tamper_after_anchor_detected :
    (run E0 full init [.append 5, .anchor, .rewrite [7], .verify [7]]).accepted = [] ∧
    (run E0 full init [.append 5, .append 6, .anchor, .rewrite [6, 5], .verify [6, 5]]).accepted = []

4.declaration_header: theorem halt_freezes (E : Env) (s : St) (ops : List Op) (hh : s.halted = true) : run E full s ops = s

5.declaration_header:
theorem sc27_ext_safe (E : Env) (ops : List Op)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (chainHead E.H E.h0) {l | l ∈ (run E true init ops).accepted ∨
      ∃ a ∈ (run E true init ops).anchors, a.2 = l}) :
    ∀ m ∈ (run E true init ops).accepted,
      (∃ a ∈ (run E true init ops).anchors, a.2 = m) ∧ ∃ l, (run E true init ops).last = some l ∧ m <+: l

6.declaration_header:
theorem tampered_never_anchored (E : Env) (s : St) (hs : Inv E s) (ops : List Op) (l : List ℕ)
    (hl : ∃ a ∈ s.anchors, a.2 = l) :
    ∀ a ∈ (run E true s ops).anchors, a ∈ s.anchors ∨ l <+: a.2

7.declaration_header:
theorem anchors_chain (E : Env) (ops : List Op) :
    (run E true init ops).anchors.Pairwise (fun a b => a.2 <+: b.2) ∧
      ∀ a ∈ (run E true init ops).anchors, ∃ l, (run E true init ops).last = some l ∧ a.2 <+: l

8.declaration_header:
theorem alarm_iff (E : Env) (s : St) :
    ((step E true s .anchor).alarms = s.alarms ++ [s.log] ↔ extendsLast s = false) ∧
      (extendsLast s = false → (step E true s .anchor).anchors = s.anchors)

9.declaration_header:
theorem concrete_ext_safe (E : Env) (ops : List COp) (ht : TraceInj E cinit ops)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (chainHead E.H E.h0) {l | l ∈ (runC E false cinit ops).accepted ∨
      ∃ a ∈ ancs (runC E false cinit ops).wlog, a.2 = l}) :
    ∀ m ∈ (runC E false cinit ops).accepted,
      (∃ a ∈ ancs (runC E false cinit ops).wlog, a.2 = m) ∧
        ∃ l, (runC E false cinit ops).ghostLast = some l ∧ m <+: l

10.declaration_header:
theorem concrete_tampered_never_anchored (E : Env) (pre post : List COp) (ht : TraceInj E cinit (pre ++ post))
    (l : List ℕ) (hl : ∃ a ∈ ancs (runC E false cinit pre).wlog, a.2 = l) :
    ∀ a ∈ ancs (runC E false cinit (pre ++ post)).wlog, a ∈ ancs (runC E false cinit pre).wlog ∨ l <+: a.2
